FILED s521c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the #1576 one-file acceptance run of Mojo-DOM58 t/dom.t: now that subtest runs, the file's FIRST assertion dies.

REPRO (dist-specific; probed, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL on 0b836815 + s521c):
    use lib '/home/bernt/.cpan/build/Mojo-DOM58-3.002-0/lib';
    use Test::More; use Mojo::DOM58;
    is(Mojo::DOM58->new, '', 'is');     # PCL dies: Can't use string ("0") as a HASH ref while "strict refs" in use
    done_testing;
perl: ok 1 - is.  The SAME object through a variable passes on PCL (`my $d = Mojo::DOM58->new; is($d, '', 'is')` -> ok), and `f(Mojo::DOM58->new)` into a plain sub, `scalar(Mojo::DOM58->new)` and `"$d"` all work.  The emitted call is `(pl-is (p-scalar (p-scalar-ctx (p-method-call ... "new"))) "" "is")`.  Mojo::DOM58 overloads '@{}', '%{}', bool and '""'; a dist-free class with the same overloads and the same `new` did NOT reproduce (scratch/s521c/pr/mojo3.pl) -- the next step is to shrink Mojo::DOM58 itself.
REACH: Mojo-DOM58 t/dom.t stops at its first row (perl: 126 top-level rows).


=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 6 (Mojo-DOM58) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.


=== DONE (s531d) ===
REDUCED (dist-free): the die needs (a) an object that is a blessed SCALAR ref to a scalar holding a blessed hash ref (`bless \Inner->new, $class`), (b) a deref of it through a reference VALUE, not a variable -- `"" . scalar(Outer->new)` hands p-. the bare is-ref box, and the '""' handler's `${$_[0]}` -- and (c) a method whose `my $self = shift` lowers through p-my-= (Mojo::DOM58::_HTML::tree's `return ... unless @_`).  cl/pcl-runtime.lisp p-cast-$'s box arm returned the referent box's bare PAYLOAD (the raw hash table) for a reference value (through a variable, `$$r`, it already returned the box); the raw hash reached the method as its invocant and box-set stored its KEY COUNT, 0 -> "Can't use string ("0") as a HASH ref".
FIXED: a hash / array / code payload answers the referent BOX (the box IS the reference) -- the symbolic arm's #3394 rule, one function.  This is also #3827's first shape (`print ${\$x}` spread the array); see #3827.  A p-scalar-only alternative (do not peel a ref-holding container) fixed Mojo's spelling but not `${ \ K->new }->m` / `bless \..` returned bare -- rejected for the one shared point.
Guard: Pl/t/scalar-deref-value-01.t (3 rows, all FAIL on ade297e7).  Board: Mojo-DOM58 dom.t row 1 passes (one-file); the file now runs 8 top-level rows (6 pass) and dies later -- rows 3, 8, *PLAN* re-caused UNREDUCED #4221 (filed; the same three symptoms with the p-scalar-only variant, so they are not this change).  HTTP-Message message.t 86/87 (#3827) pass -> left by edit.
